query: UPDATE remote_signing_sessions AS s SET state_sha256 = NULL, pkce_sealed = NULL, code_sealed = $5, status = $6 FROM (SELECT id, pkce_sealed FROM remote_signing_sessions WHERE account_id = $1 AND recipient_id = $2 AND state_sha256 = $3 AND status = $4 AND closed_at IS NULL AND expires_at > $7 FOR UPDATE) AS old WHERE s.account_id = $1 AND s.id = old.id RETURNING s.id, old.pkce_sealed AS pkce
